summary: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance and sale of $107 million aggregate principal amount of 7.50% Senior Unsecured Convertible Notes due 2031. The notes are convertible into ordinary shares at an initial conversion price of approximately $25.4826 per share, maturing June 15, 2031. Interest is payable semi-annually, at the company's election, in cash or shares. The offering closed on June 5, 2026, yielding net proceeds of about $102.4 million. Benchmark and StoneX served as placement agents. Directors and officers entered into 120-day lock-up agreements. This is a routine shelf takedown under an existing effective shelf registration statement; no special-situation event such as a strategic review, activist campaign, or other transformative transaction is present.
